decisions.reason: Margin analysis extends the firm's core market-data offer, has its own web page and draws on maintained databases, so low marginal cost and growing industry turnover give no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
Gas tariff comparison sits close to the established offer and is presented on its own page, so it likely meets aspiration levels at low incremental cost.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a core-adjacent product with its own page that uses existing data, so there is little reason for problemistic search to remove it.
It is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the electricity calculator, so it could be consolidated, but slack in a growing industry lets the firm carry it for now.
The area definition tool underpins the location-based products, has its own page, and fits the central platform strategy.
Site-specific comparison is only mentioned on the website and may be merged into other comparison tools, but its closeness to the core and low cost favour keeping it.
